narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The distance is six, so the movement is positive six.
<bookmark mark='far'/>Positive six goes forward from nine, and the train lands on fifteen, far from station three.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The train must go backward, so the distance alone is not enough. The direction matters too.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Going backward along the number line is a negative movement, and it equals the target minus the start.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. From eight, what movement takes you to four along the number line?
